configuration: the shipped 3-D cone deck at 64x64x64 cells over 20x20x20 micron, 25 fs of its 50 fs physical window, and dumps 1 and 2 at 12.5 fs; the deck remains a four-times-critical hollow cone driven by simple_laser and absorbed at simple_outflow
observable: weighted physical scalars at every graded dump: total electron number (the sole particle-count observable; signed charge is algebraically -e times this count and is not serialized or graded), total electron kinetic energy, total electromagnetic energy, electron-density centroids and RMS spreads on each axis, and integrated absolute Jx; no cellwise arrays
default_vs_upstream: The checked resolution/window/cadence are the task defaults; the run.sh SAB_* knobs restore the upstream resolution, full physical time, and full dump cadence.
variant: The laser amplitude/intensity is unchanged. The explicit four-rank MPI layout changes from 2x2x1 -> 1x1x4; 64x64x64 is divisible by both layouts. EPOCH seeds its KISS random stream from 7842432 + rank (src/housekeeping/random_generator.f90 and src/housekeeping/setup.F90), so this is an implementation-independent particle realization rather than same-stream laser sensitivity.
altbuild: run.sh altbuild retains the existing shipped-gfortran -O0 alternative build; a fresh altbuild calibration is required after this contract revision.

evidence.calibration_status: PENDING: no science run or selfcheck was launched in this revision; parent must calibrate N/V/altbuild across independent layouts before acceptance.
evidence.provisional_tolerance_basis: Relative bounds are deliberately per-observable: 10% for electron number, 20% for particle and field energy, 25% for integrated current; centroid/RMS bounds are 2e-6 m. Charge is not a second metric because it is exactly -e times electron number. These are reviewable provisional ceilings, not measured calibration claims.

warrant: The reviewed pointwise contract was invalid because random PIC loading can change cellwise realization across GPU/rank layouts. This check now uses the shipped 3-D cone deck at 64x64x64 cells over 20x20x20 micron, 25 fs of its 50 fs physical window, and dumps 1 and 2 at 12.5 fs; the deck remains a four-times-critical hollow cone driven by simple_laser and absorbed at simple_outflow. The extractor weights electron number density by cell volume for number, weights mean electron energy by electron density for total kinetic energy, and computes the electromagnetic energy density eps0|E|^2/2 + |B|^2/(2 mu0) from EPOCH's emitted grid fields. Density centroids and RMS spreads are physical spatial moments at cell centers; integrated |Jx| is a norm of the driven current, not a positional comparison. These observables remain defined at both dumps, cover the complete retained physical-time window, and fail closed on missing, non-finite, or non-scalar outputs. The variant preserves the laser physics and changes only a valid MPI decomposition, which exercises EPOCH's rank-seeded stream independently. The deterministic vacuum laser checks elsewhere in this leaf remain pointwise and untouched. Calibration across at least the two shipped layouts plus one additional valid layout, followed by nominal/variant/altbuild selfcheck, is required to replace the provisional bounds.

geometry_contract.mesh: Grid/Grid node coordinates must be finite, strictly increasing, and have exactly cells+1 nodes per axis
geometry_contract.cell_volume: V[i,j(,k)] = prod(axis_nodes[a+1] - axis_nodes[a]) over all spatial axes
geometry_contract.fail_closed: density/mean energy/EM density nonnegative; all required arrays exact-shape and finite; all scalar outputs finite
